name: Text-to-Lottie Skill (Diffusion Studio)
purpose: Prompt-driven generation of declarative Lottie JSON vector animations, icon bursts, and UI state indicators.
capabilities: Prompt to Lottie JSON schema generation
Vector shape, trim-path, and keyframe choreography recipes
Deterministic frame-by-frame stepping via lottie-web in HyperFrames

installation.instructions: Recipe instructions incorporated into motion-library-guide. Consumed via lottie-web runtime.

compatibility.notes: Verified in HyperFrames with lottie-web SVG renderer on Apple Silicon M2 (120 frames in 10.7s at 1280x720 30fps).

security.notes: Instructional skill guidelines for Lottie JSON generation.

approval_evidence: Prototyped in tests/prototypes/lottie/. Rendered 120 frames at 1280x720 @ 30fps with 0 dropped frames. Verified deterministic seeking via anim.goToAndStop(playhead.frame, true). Retained as experimental capability.
